verdict.line: You lose if you walk into his Q (Rupture) and eat the W (Feral Scream) silence that follows it; you win if you bait that Rupture onto a minion first and then stick to him.

brief.thesis: Cho'Gath's entire threat in this lane is the Q (Rupture, 9s cd) into W (Feral Scream, 13s cd) silence combo — outside that window he has no disengage and no reliable way to punish extended melee, since Vorpal Spikes is just a passive proc on his own autos. Irelia's Q (Bladesurge) dashes onto a unit, not a location, so she can close distance onto a minion instead of walking into Rupture's knockup and slow, which is exactly what OP.GG's own note tells you to do. The 158-game head-to-head sitting at 50% reflects that both sides' power swings hard around whether that one Rupture lands clean or gets baited.

theirWindow.what: The knockup and slow give him a free follow-up to walk in and land W (Feral Scream) silence before you can react. Back off and let the slow tick down instead of fighting through it.

yourWindow.when: After he whiffs Q (Rupture) on a minion
yourWindow.what: His Q is down for 9 seconds with no knockup, no slow, and no silence setup behind it. Dash in with Q (Bladesurge) on a minion near him to close the gap safely, then stick on him in melee where his only damage is the Vorpal Spikes passive.

powerCurve.note: Both weak, poke with autos only
Rupture into Feral Scream silence snowballs
R (Vanguard's Edge) unlocks all-in kill threat
BORK/Hullbreaker online, skirmishes swing your way

start.why: Sustain to win the extended melee trades OP.GG's own tip tells you to force, since that's where Cho'Gath has no answer once his cooldowns are down.

boots.why: Magic resist blunts his Q and W magic damage, and the tenacity shortens the W (Feral Scream) silence window he relies on to lock you down.

core.why: The on-hit slow punishes his lack of mobility and lets you stick through extended trades instead of getting kited by autos.
The power spike synergizes with Bladesurge resets off minions, turning your bait-the-Q wave trades into real pressure.
Converts his Rupture + Feral Scream burst into a bleed you can out-heal mid-fight instead of eating it all at once.

situational.when: he builds magic resist or you need sustained damage to out-trade his autos
you want to prioritize wave clear and splitpush pressure over straight dueling
he's stacked enough Feast kills that his point-blank true-damage R threatens to end fights outright

runes.keystoneWhy: The adaptive damage and healing ramp up the longer the fight runs, directly rewarding the prolonged melee combat OP.GG's tip tells you to force.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 84.4% of games and secures kills off your Q into E all-in; Exhaust+Flash is the higher-winrate pick (52.9%) if you'd rather blunt his Rupture-Scream burst directly.

playing.title: Bait Rupture onto a minion
playing.detail: Use Q (Bladesurge) on a minion near him to close distance without walking into his Q directly — Bladesurge targets a unit, so it dodges the ground-targeted knockup entirely.

playing.title: Track the 9-second Rupture timer
playing.detail: Once he whiffs or burns Q, he has no knockup, no slow, and no setup for the Feral Scream silence combo for 9 full seconds — that's your window to commit.

playing.title: Don't facecheck his W range
playing.detail: Feral Scream is a 300-range cone that silences — approach from an angle where you can react, not straight on, or it shuts down your E follow-up before you throw it.

playing.title: Hold E until he's already committed
playing.detail: Flawless Duet's blades converge on each other, so throw it once he's locked into melee range after Rupture rather than from a distance where he can walk out of the collapse.

playing.title: All-in at level 6
playing.detail: R (Vanguard's Edge) adds mark and wall damage on top of your Q-E combo — this is your first real power spike, so look to force the fight here rather than waiting.

playing.title: Respect Feast once it's up
playing.detail: His R is a 175-range true-damage devour on a 60s cooldown — keep an HP buffer after he hits level 6 so a point-blank Feast can't finish you outright.

playing.title: Rush Death's Dance into skirmishes
playing.detail: The Rupture-into-Scream combo is a heavy magic burst; Death's Dance turns it into a bleed your lifesteal and healing can catch up to mid-fight.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1, 158-game sample for this matchup); the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Cho’Gath’s (Q). Close in by using [Q] on minions to have a prolonged melee combat for a chance to kill.
